kind: declared descriptive protected secondaries; post-unblinding implementation

conventions.score_weighting: equal planets within every subset; equal accepted events within each planet; saved full-cohort weight column ignored
conventions.score_scope: conditional on accepted timings; no imputation

lead_time.qualification: coarse metadata proxy; UTC and BJD_TDB have not been converted to a common scale or reference; not an exact UTC-to-BJD conversion

tmag.status: existing development bin boundaries adopted for protected descriptive reporting on 2026-11-09, after unblinding; not fixed original protected bins
tmag.continuous_table: planet_metrics.csv and planet_deltas.csv retain continuous Tmag

conventions.covariance_tier: from frozen forecasts, including C3; not inferred from protected outcomes
conventions.product: SPOC_120 only, from the frozen SPOC 120-s PDCSAP scope; no other product comparison is available
conventions.recovery: accepted/all intended and accepted among coverage-qualified/coverage-qualified; qualification requires both saved prediction window and in-transit coverage >=0.75 (terminal ledger boolean); unknown stays separate; planet-balanced recovery averages planet-specific fractions over planets with a denominator
conventions.coverage_at_prediction_role: recovery denominator diagnostic, not a timing acceptance gate; accepted timings with unqualified prediction coverage remain accepted and scored

current_catalogue_ttv.ttv_source: NASA Exoplanet Archive Planetary Systems table, current default rows
current_catalogue_ttv.scope: current catalogue flag diagnostic retrieved after unblinding; source selected independently without reading scores; descriptive only
current_catalogue_ttv.limits: raw flag 0 means catalogue-unflagged with physical TTV status unknown, never no-TTV; missing, ambiguous or mismatched joins remain unknown; retrieval and parameter dates are not TTV discovery dates; new-since-origin status remains unknown; no cohort exclusions or primary changes

conventions.influence: fixed per-planet M2-M0 standardized IS95; host contribution=sum(planet deltas)/original N; rank negative contributions ascending, alphabetical host ties; remove whole hosts and give remaining planets equal weight; k=0..5; k beyond available gain hosts is explicitly unavailable
conventions.combined_descriptive: core and extension pooled only for description, with equal planets; does not change either frozen analysis
conventions.empty_cells: zero counts and blank metrics; planets without accepted timings remain in recovery and continuous tables, with blank scores/deltas
conventions.inference: descriptive only; no subgroup significance rule, bootstrap/refit, primary exclusion or revised primary decision
